description: This file defines the class `GenericDataSourceException`, which is a custom exception class extending `GenericEntityException`. It is used to handle exceptions related to data source operations in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDataSourceException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to represent data source related errors, extending the `GenericEntityException` class. It provides constructors for default, message-based, and nested Throwable exceptions.

methods.name: GenericDataSourceException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes a new instance of the exception without message or cause.

methods.name: GenericDataSourceException(String str)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the exception with a specified detail message.

methods.name: GenericDataSourceException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the exception with a specified message and nested cause.
